top10.text: We're raising our seed round. Literally. It's birdseed. Two million dollars, and we already ate the term sheet.
We're the Uber for breadcrumbs: on-demand, same-day delivery, and our drivers eat forty percent of every order.
I'm the coo-founder. My co-founder is also a pigeon. Our cap table is a park bench and our board meets on a statue.
We poop on statues. That's not a bug, it's our moat: ten thousand years of brand presence no competitor can replicate.

top10.pattern: pivot on one leg / burn rate breadcrumbs
top10.text: We pivot. On one leg. In the middle of traffic. Our burn rate is breadcrumbs and we have never once missed a runway.
Our network effects are literal: we're a flock. Every new pigeon makes every other pigeon ten percent harder to ignore.
Pigeon post, rebuilt for the cloud era. We deliver your message in three to five business days, or whenever we feel like it.

top10.pattern: zero churn / can't leave the park
top10.text: Our churn is zero. Our users can't leave the park. Neither can we. We're raising to find out why.
Our TAM is every park bench on Earth. Our SAM is the ones with crumbs. Our SOM is this one, right here, under my feet.
We're raising our Series A. The A stands for 'Aww, look, a pigeon.' Our last round was a crumb round.
